on the 3-torsion the step has order 8, on the 5-torsion order 4
symmetry group of the 5-torsion: 120 elements, 9 classes, element orders as the binary icosahedral group
its two-dimensional representation has traces 2, -2, -1, 1, 0, +-phi, +-(phi - 1): exactly the spectrum of the extended E8 diagram
the marks of the record's network are the dimensions of the nine representations: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 4, 2, 3 with squares summing to 120; top value 2, next value phi (gap 2 - phi)
the step is not in that group (determinant 2, not a square modulo 5); it acts on it from outside and swaps the two classes of order five, the exchange of sqrt 5 with -sqrt 5
3-torsion: 24 elements, 7 classes (binary tetrahedral); spectrum of the extended E6 diagram 2, 1, 1, 0, -1, -1, -2 equals its traces
control: for the 7-torsion the group has 336 elements; no extended E diagram has that order (24, 48, 120 only)
control: the 4-torsion gives 48 elements but not the binary octahedral group (that one has exactly one element of order two)
